bio.text: James Wiley is the Republican Party nominee for Colorado Secretary of State in the 2026 general election.

In a KRDO candidate questionnaire he described himself as a fifth-generation Colorado native who graduated from Pueblo County High School and earned a management and marketing degree and an MBA at CSU-Pueblo.
He also said he previously served as executive director of the Libertarian Party of Colorado.

sources.title: James Wiley (2026 Secretary of State Race)
